dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped silver-grey structures are visible. The most prominent is an irregular, large 'C' shape in the mid-dorsal region with a sharp, jagged exterior boundary. Two smaller, closed 'O' shapes are located anteriorly, featuring thin, high-intensity perimeters that transition sharply into darker interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low overall density of solid blobs; the texture is primarily characterized by annuli. A localized cluster of small, high-intensity silver-white flecks lacking internal gradients is visible in the transition zone between the neck and the dorsal shoulder region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. The relative distance between the two anterior 'O' rings is approximately half the distance from either 'O' ring to the centroid of the large mid-dorsal 'C' structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly reflective, silver-dominant texture on the rostral and facial area which contrasts with the matte dark-grey tone of the lateral body pelt.
